reason: The H3 hierarchy requires Z10 to solve the same reduced Einstein+AeST+dust linear system used in L_total. GE18 certifies the pressureless matter subsystem on the frozen GE15 full-standard-matter metric, but it did not re-solve metric/AeST backreaction after replacing the full standard sector by effective dust. Therefore an internally coupled reduced H1 reclosure is a logical prerequisite to the Z20 source.

stage_A_reduced_H1.modes: only the six frozen input Fourier modes m={3,5,8,10,15,20}
stage_A_reduced_H1.initial_values_and_derivatives: match the frozen physically weighted GE15 metric/AeST direction and GE18 dust bridge exactly at z=1.5
stage_A_reduced_H1.interpretation: unique window-reclosed reduced first-order state for the later GE19 H3 source; it is not a replacement/relabel of the full-standard CLASS solution

stage_B_change: GE19 Q_total and Y2 must be evaluated on Z10_reduced from Stage A, not directly on the frozen GE15+GE18 mixed first-order trajectory. The GE15/GE18 trajectories remain provenance and comparison references.
unchanged_from_original_GE19: no finite eta or physical-amplitude interpretation
stop_rule: If Stage A fails any frozen H1 reclosure gate, GE19 terminates FAIL before constructing/interpreting Z20. Do not tune the reduced matter model, initial match, gauge or thresholds.
claim_boundary: A later GE19 PASS requires both an internally on-shell reduced Z10 and the preregistered window-retarded Z20 particular solve. Historical GE15/GE18 classifications remain unchanged.
